Round 2: if demand is strong, probe upward (about 3.25 to 3.5) to check whether the optimum is higher. If demand is weak, probe downward (about 2.25 to 2.5). Under a uniform willingness-to-pay model, the profit-maximizing price is about 2.75 (half of the ceiling plus half of the cost, i.e., (4.51 + 1)/2 ≈ 2.755). This is a hypothesis, not yet confirmed by data. Revise it as real sales and the platform's optimal-price estimates come in.
